front.title: FN-DSA Signature Authentication in IKEv2 with Public Key Recovery Mode

abstract.t: This document specifies FN-DSA for signature authentication in the Internet Key Exchange Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2). It defines Public Key Recovery Mode (PKR-Mode), an extension that exploits the public key recovery property of FN-DSA, which reduces authentication payload size and enables certificateless authentication at the responder.
